exposure: Previous uterine surgery (including caesarean sections and myomectomies)
cohort: 35 patients who underwent microwave endometrial ablation (MEA), divided into groups with and without previous uterine surgery.
finding: Microwave endometrial ablation (MEA) can be performed safely and effectively for patients with previous uterine surgery, with no complications reported and no difference in recurrence rate between groups with and without previous uterine surgery.
mod_finding: The study found that MEA can be performed safely and effectively even for patients with previous uterine surgery, which includes caesarean sections, suggesting that a previous caesarean section does not increase the risk of complications or recurrence after MEA.
